summary: The diff implements REQ-3 (packaging scripts), REQ-4 (Linux installation guide), and partially addresses documentation. However, REQ-1 (Vite relative base path configuration) and REQ-2 (GPIO HTTP endpoint change to http://localhost:3000) are not implemented in the diff. Additionally, the INSTALL.md was placed in frontend/INSTALL.md rather than as a top-level bundle README, and vite.config.ts and gpioHttp.ts files are not modified.
